summary: Session 13 (mobile JWT auth + Pratyantardasha + Yoga engine) fully validated. 39/39 backend pytest cases passed including: mobile signup (success, 409 dup, 400 invalid email/short pw/short name), mobile login (200 success, 401 wrong pw, 429 brute-force lockout after 5 fails), /mobile/me (200 with user token, 401 with admin token, 401 without token), /mobile/logout (token blacklisted → next /me=401), cross-token isolation (user token works on /kundli/generate, /kundli/my, /charts/d1-d9, /dasha/current, /yogas), Pratyantardasha (9 PDs returned, current PD window contains now, sum of PD years ≈ AD years, first PD planet == AD planet), Yoga engine (5 canonical yogas always returned with shape/strength/summary; rule-correctness unit tests for Raj/Dhan/Gaj Kesari/Chandra-Mangal/Neech Bhang Raj on synthetic kundlis; _strength_bucket and _planet_status combust/exalted/debilitated logic), and admin regression (/auth/admin/login + /charts/d1-d9 + /yogas). Static analysis of /app/expo-app: AuthProvider/RootGate/AuthStack/MainTabs wiring is correct; AuthContext bootstraps via /auth/mobile/me; axios response interceptor (client.js line 85-94) NO LONGER auto-retries 401 with admin creds — security fix verified, only clears local token. Mobile UI itself is React Native (Expo), not Playwright-testable.
critical_code_review_comments: yoga_engine.py: clean rule-based design; SIGN_LORDS/EXALTATION/DEBILITATION/OWN_SIGNS tables correct; _aspects_house implements special aspects for Mars(4/8), Jupiter(5/9), Saturn(3/10), Rahu/Ketu(5/9). detect_all_yogas always returns 5 canonical entries — UI-friendly.

dasha_engine.compute_pratyantardashas: PD years = (AD × sub) / 120 verified mathematically; PD sequence starts from AD planet; sum of 9 PDs ≈ AD years (test asserts within 0.05y rounding tolerance) — passes.

server.py mobile auth: signup validates email/password>=6/name>=2 and returns 400; duplicate returns 409; login uses bcrypt verify_password + login_attempts collection with identifier=ip:email:mobile, locks after 5 fails for 15 min — confirmed via test that returned 429.

get_current_app_user (server.py:5358): correctly checks Bearer header AND cookie, validates type=='access' and role=='user'. Note: cookie is checked BEFORE Bearer header — this means an admin web cookie + a user Bearer header would prefer the cookie (admin token) and reject with 401 'Not a mobile user token'. In production this is fine (mobile clients don't have web cookies), but test code must use a clean session. Documented in test fixture.

axios interceptor security fix (expo-app/src/api/client.js:85-94): on 401, only clears AsyncStorage token + USER_KEY; does NOT auto-retry with admin creds. The previous behaviour would have silently downgraded user sessions to admin — confirmed removed.

Suggestion: brute-force lockout uses identifier = ip:email:mobile. If two different users share an IP and one is attacked, the other is unaffected (good). However, lockout only resets on successful login; consider a TTL index on login_attempts so abandoned identifiers self-clean. Non-blocking.
Suggestion: /api/auth/mobile/signup returns the JWT immediately without email verification. Acceptable for v1 mobile; flag for future hardening (email OTP).
